newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq to axe Sky TV from pubs - paper.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq to axe Sky TV from pubs - paper.

text.p: Allied Domecq Plc, the food and drinks giant, is to axe the Sky television channel from 200 of its branded pubs in protest against high prices charged by British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc, said the Independent on Thursday.
The report said the move followed other pub groups -- a major source of viewers for the satellite television broadcaster.
Rising prices for the services meant it was no longer viable to run the channel in pubs including the Big Steak, Wacky Warehouses and Firkin chains.
Martin Grialey, marketing director of Allied Domecq Leisure, was quoted stating that one fifth of its branded pubs would withdraw Sky.
